SELECT
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t ORDER BY t.nama ASC), '[]'::json) FROM (
    SELECT u."NIP" AS id, u."NIP" AS nip, u."username" AS nama,
           COALESCE(u."Jabatan"::text, '') AS jabatan,
           COALESCE(u.instansi_id::text, '') AS instansi_id
    FROM public.user_list u
    WHERE u."NIP" IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY u."username" ASC
  ) t) AS pegawai,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t ORDER BY t.nomorinventaris ASC), '[]'::json) FROM (
    SELECT ua.id, ua.nomorinventaris, ua.kondisi, ua.statuspinjam, ua.qrcode,
           ua.pegawai_id, ua.ruangan_id,
           COALESCE(ua.no_polisi, '') AS no_polisi, COALESCE(ua.no_rangka, '') AS no_rangka,
           COALESCE(ua.no_mesin, '') AS no_mesin, COALESCE(ua.roda, '') AS roda,
           COALESCE(ua.merk_type, '') AS merk_type, COALESCE(ua.model_jenis, '') AS model_jenis,
           COALESCE(ua.warna, '') AS warna, COALESCE(ua.tahun_pembuatan, '') AS tahun_pembuatan,
           b.nama AS nama_barang, COALESCE(b.kodebarang, '') AS kodebarang, b.kategoriid,
           COALESCE(k.nama, '') AS kategori_nama, COALESCE(b.hargasatuan, 0) AS harga
    FROM "SIMAPO".unit_aset ua
    JOIN "SIMAPO".barang b ON b.id = ua.barangid AND b.isactive = true
    LEFT JOIN "SIMAPO".kategori_barang k ON k.id = b.kategoriid
  ) t) AS aset,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t ORDER BY t.nama ASC), '[]'::json) FROM (
    SELECT r.id, r.kode, r.nama, COALESCE(r.keterangan, '') AS keterangan
    FROM "SIMAPO".ruangan r
  ) t) AS ruangan,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t ORDER BY t.nama ASC), '[]'::json) FROM (
    SELECT u."NIP" AS id, u."NIP" AS nip, u."username" AS nama, COALESCE(u."Jabatan"::text, '') AS jabatan
    FROM public.user_list u
    WHERE u."NIP" IS NOT NULL
  ) t) AS penandatangan;

UPDATE "SIMAPO".unit_aset

    no_polisi = {{ ($input.item.json.body.no_polisi ? ("'" + String($input.item.json.body.no_polisi).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'") : "no_polisi") }},
    no_rangka = {{ ($input.item.json.body.no_rangka ? ("'" + String($input.item.json.body.no_rangka).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'") : "no_rangka") }},
    no_mesin = {{ ($input.item.json.body.no_mesin ? ("'" + String($input.item.json.body.no_mesin).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'") : "no_mesin") }},
    roda = {{ ($input.item.json.body.roda ? ("'" + String($input.item.json.body.roda).replace(/[^0-9]/g, '') + "'") : "roda") }},
    merk_type = {{ ($input.item.json.body.merk_type ? ("'" + String($input.item.json.body.merk_type).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'") : "merk_type") }},
    model_jenis = {{ ($input.item.json.body.model_jenis ? ("'" + String($input.item.json.body.model_jenis).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'") : "model_jenis") }},
    warna = {{ ($input.item.json.body.warna ? ("'" + String($input.item.json.body.warna).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'") : "warna") }},
    tahun_pembuatan = {{ ($input.item.json.body.tahun_pembuatan ? ("'" + String($input.item.json.body.tahun_pembuatan).replace(/[^0-9]/g, '') + "'") : "tahun_pembuatan") }},
    updatedat = NOW()
WHERE id = '{{ ($input.item.json.body.aset_id).toString().replace(/[^0-9a-f-]/gi, '') }}'
RETURNING id, pegawai_id, ruangan_id;

const b = $input.item.json.body || {};
const esc = s => String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/'/g, "''");
const id = b.id ? "'" + esc(b.id) + "'" : 'gen_random_uuid()';
const tanggal = b.tanggal ? "'" + esc(b.tanggal) + "'::timestamptz" : 'NULL';
const daset = JSON.stringify(b.daftar_aset || []).replace(/'/g, "''");
const sql = `INSERT INTO "SIMAPO".bast (
  id, nomor, instansi_id, pegawai_id, pegawai_nama, pegawai_nip, pegawai_jabatan,
  pegawai_alamat, penandatangan_id, penandatangan_nama, penandatangan_nip,
  penandatangan_jabatan, penandatangan_alamat, tanggal, hari_tanggal, tempat,
  daftar_aset, total_aset, total_nilai, createdat, createdby
) VALUES (
  ${id},
  '${esc(b.nomor)}',
  '${esc(b.instansi_id || 'bapperida')}',
  ${b.pegawai_id ? "'" + esc(b.pegawai_id) + "'" : 'NULL'},
  '${esc(b.pegawai_nama)}',
  '${esc(b.pegawai_nip)}',
  '${esc(b.pegawai_jabatan)}',
  '${esc(b.pegawai_alamat)}',
  '${esc(b.penandatangan_id)}',
  '${esc(b.penandatangan_nama)}',
  '${esc(b.penandatangan_nip)}',
  '${esc(b.penandatangan_jabatan)}',
  '${esc(b.penandatangan_alamat)}',
  ${tanggal},
  '${esc(b.hari_tanggal)}',
  '${esc(b.tempat)}',
  '${daset}'::jsonb,
  ${Number(b.total_aset) || 0},
  ${Number(b.total_nilai) || 0},
  NOW(),
  '${esc(b.createdby)}'
)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
  nomor = EXCLUDED.nomor, pegawai_id = EXCLUDED.pegawai_id,
  pegawai_nama = EXCLUDED.pegawai_nama, pegawai_nip = EXCLUDED.pegawai_nip,
  pegawai_jabatan = EXCLUDED.pegawai_jabatan, pegawai_alamat = EXCLUDED.pegawai_alamat,
  penandatangan_id = EXCLUDED.penandatangan_id, penandatangan_nama = EXCLUDED.penandatangan_nama,
  penandatangan_nip = EXCLUDED.penandatangan_nip, penandatangan_jabatan = EXCLUDED.penandatangan_jabatan,
  penandatangan_alamat = EXCLUDED.penandatangan_alamat, tanggal = EXCLUDED.tanggal,
  hari_tanggal = EXCLUDED.hari_tanggal, tempat = EXCLUDED.tempat, daftar_aset = EXCLUDED.daftar_aset,
  total_aset = EXCLUDED.total_aset, total_nilai = EXCLUDED.total_nilai, updatedat = NOW(),
  createdby = EXCLUDED.createdby
RETURNING id, nomor, pegawai_id, total_aset;`;
return [{ json: { sql } }];

INSERT INTO "SIMAPO".ruangan (kode, nama, keterangan, instansi_id)
VALUES ('{{ (($input.item.json.body.kode) || "").toString().replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
        '{{ (($input.item.json.body.nama) || "").toString().replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
        '{{ (($input.item.json.body.keterangan) || "").toString().replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
        '{{ (($input.item.json.body.instansi_id || "bapperida")).toString().replace(/'/g, "''") }}')
ON CONFLICT (kode, instansi_id) DO UPDATE SET
  nama = EXCLUDED.nama, keterangan = EXCLUDED.keterangan
RETURNING id, kode, nama;

SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t ORDER BY t.createdat DESC), '[]'::json) AS items FROM (
  SELECT b.id, b.nomor, b.pegawai_id, b.pegawai_nama, b.pegawai_nip, b.pegawai_jabatan,
         b.penandatangan_nama, b.tanggal, b.hari_tanggal, b.tempat, b.daftar_aset, b.total_aset,
         b.total_nilai, b.createdat, b.createdby
  FROM "SIMAPO".bast b
  WHERE b.instansi_id = '{{ ($json.query.instansi_id || "bapperida").toString().replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
) t;

WITH bid AS (
    SELECT id FROM "SIMAPO".barang
    WHERE kodebarang = '{{ (($input.item.json.body.kodebarang) || "").toString().replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
      AND nama = '{{ (($input.item.json.body.nama) || "").toString().replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
      AND instansi_id = '{{ (($input.item.json.body.instansi_id) || "bapperida").toString().replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
  ),
  barang_ins AS (
    INSERT INTO "SIMAPO".barang (id, kodebarang, nama, jenisbarang, satuan, stok_saat_ini, minimumstok, hargasatuan, kategoriid, isactive, createdat, updatedat, instansi_id)
    SELECT md5('{{ (($input.item.json.body.instansi_id) || "bapperida").toString().replace(/'/g, "''") }}:' || '{{ (($input.item.json.body.kodebarang) || "").toString().replace(/'/g, "''") }}' || ':' || '{{ (($input.item.json.body.nama) || "").toString().replace(/'/g, "''") }}'),
           '{{ (($input.item.json.body.kodebarang) || "").toString().replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
           '{{ (($input.item.json.body.nama) || "").toString().replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
           'Aset Tetap', 'unit', 1, 0,
           {{ Math.max(0, Number(($input.item.json.body.hargasatuan) || 0)) }},
           {{ ($input.item.json.body.kategoriid ? ("'" + String($input.item.json.body.kategoriid).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'") : "NULL") }},
           true, NOW(), NOW(),
           '{{ (($input.item.json.body.instansi_id) || "bapperida").toString().replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bid)
    RETURNING id
  ),
  nu AS (
    SELECT gen_random_uuid() AS id
  ),
  unit_ins AS (
    INSERT INTO "SIMAPO".unit_aset (id, barangid, nomorinventaris, kondisi, statuspinjam, qrcode, nilaiperolehan, tahunperolehan, pegawai_id, ruangan_id, no_polisi, no_rangka, no_mesin, roda, merk_type, model_jenis, warna, tahun_pembuatan, updatedat)
    SELECT (SELECT id FROM nu),
           COALESCE((SELECT id FROM bid), (SELECT id FROM barang_ins)),
           '{{ (($input.item.json.body.nomorinventaris) || "").toString().replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
           '{{ (($input.item.json.body.kondisi) || "Baik").toString().replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
           false,
           'https://mindcloud.my.id/?qr=SIMAPO-' || (SELECT id FROM nu),
           {{ ($input.item.json.body.nilaiperolehan != null && isFinite(Number($input.item.json.body.nilaiperolehan)) ? Number($input.item.json.body.nilaiperolehan) : "NULL") }},
           {{ ($input.item.json.body.tahunperolehan ? Number($input.item.json.body.tahunperolehan) : "NULL") }},
           {{ ($input.item.json.body.pegawai_id ? ("'" + String($input.item.json.body.pegawai_id).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'") : "NULL") }},
           {{ ($input.item.json.body.ruangan_id ? ("'" + String($input.item.json.body.ruangan_id).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'") : "NULL") }},
           '{{ (($input.item.json.body.no_polisi) || "").toString().replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
           '{{ (($input.item.json.body.no_rangka) || "").toString().replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
           '{{ (($input.item.json.body.no_mesin) || "").toString().replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
           '{{ (($input.item.json.body.roda) || "").toString().replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
           '{{ (($input.item.json.body.merk_type) || "").toString().replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
           '{{ (($input.item.json.body.model_jenis) || "").toString().replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
           '{{ (($input.item.json.body.warna) || "").toString().replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
           '{{ (($input.item.json.body.tahun_pembuatan) || "").toString().replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
           NOW()
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM "SIMAPO".unit_aset ua
      WHERE ua.nomorinventaris = '{{ (($input.item.json.body.nomorinventaris) || "").toString().replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
    )
    RETURNING id
  )
  SELECT COALESCE((SELECT id FROM bid), (SELECT id FROM barang_ins)) AS barang_id,
         (SELECT id FROM unit_ins) AS unit_id;

WITH inp AS (
  SELECT '{{ $items("WH Bast Import")[0].json.body.nomorinventaris }}'::text AS ninv,
         {{ ($items("WH Bast Import")[0].json.body.nilaiperolehan != null ? Number($items("WH Bast Import")[0].json.body.nilaiperolehan) : "NULL") }}::numeric AS nilai,
         {{ ($items("WH Bast Import")[0].json.body.tahunperolehan ? Number($items("WH Bast Import")[0].json.body.tahunperolehan) : "NULL") }}::int AS thn,
         '{{ $items("PG Bast Import")[0].json.unit_id }}'::text AS uids
)
UPDATE "SIMAPO".unit_aset ua
SET nilaiperolehan = inp.nilai,
    tahunperolehan = inp.thn,
    barangid = COALESCE(
      (SELECT b.id FROM "SIMAPO".barang b
       WHERE b.kodebarang='{{ ($items("WH Bast Import")[0].json.body.kodebarang || "").toString().replace(/'/g,"''") }}'
         AND b.nama='{{ ($items("WH Bast Import")[0].json.body.nama || "").toString().replace(/'/g,"''") }}'
         AND b.instansi_id='{{ (($items("WH Bast Import")[0].json.body.instansi_id)||"bapperida").toString().replace(/'/g,"''") }}'),
      ua.barangid),
    qrcode = 'https://mindcloud.my.id/?qr=SIMAPO-' || ua.id,
    updatedat = NOW()
FROM inp
WHERE ua.nomorinventaris = inp.ninv
RETURNING ua.barangid,
       CASE WHEN inp.uids ~ '^[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}$' THEN inp.uids::uuid END AS unit_id;
